title: Reverse scan removes the final marker
statement: Let $x$ and $w$ be Boolean words, and let $i$ be a natural number with $i \le |x|$. Starting from the stripping machine's configuration with input $x$, reverse-scan state $1$, input head past the first $i$ symbols, work tape containing $w$, work head at $|w|-1$, and empty output, there is a time $t \le 3(|w|+1)$ at which the machine has halted and its output is the prefix strictly before the last $1$ in $w$, or the empty word if $w$ has no $1$.
replaced:
From the stripping machine's reverse state with buffer $w$ and work head on
the final cell, there is a time $t \le 3(\abs{w}+1)$ after which the machine
has halted; its output is the prefix of $w$ strictly before the last $1$ bit
of $w$, and is empty when $w$ contains no $1$.
